positive_snippets:
I had stayed here for 2 days and the staff was extremely supportive during my stay.
A special thanks to the staff who was sitting at the reception.
Rooms were clean and spacious.
Food was also good.
Location is also accessible to most of the IT candour tech SEZ companies.
Had a good and comfortable stay over-all.
I've been there for 3 days, the service and room facilities are awesome. Breakfast and dinner were also good. Reasonable rate too.
Beautiful property. Very helpful staff. Highly recommend
negative_snippets: Rooms are great, very neat and looks as advertised, however there’s a huge flaw and that’s the service, had to wait 3 hours for a bottle of water and had to call multiple times for a door mat! The staffs are least interested in helping with any requirements and rude. Great place to stay but staff service needs to be improved!
